```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

The problems people actually hit, by where they show up. Each row is a symptom,
what's behind it and what to do.

## The brand file

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Quarto fails to render with a YAML validation error from `readAndValidateYamlFromFile` | `_brand.yml` is in the Shiny/bslib dialect (`color-dark:`, `theme:`), which Quarto rejects | Run any `create_brand_quarto_*()` in the project (it converts the file), or save from `configure_brand()` with **Output format: Quarto** |
| A Shiny app won't start: `color.primary must be a single string or NULL, not a list` | The file is in Quarto's dialect (nested `light:` / `dark:`), which bslib rejects | Run any `create_brand_shiny_*()` in the project, or save from `configure_brand()` with **Output format: Shiny / bslib** |
| The border radius you configured has no effect in bslib | bslib doesn't read a `theme:` key, so it silently uses Bootstrap's default | Put Bootstrap variables under `defaults: bootstrap: defaults:`. The scaffolds write them there |
| A directory with an app and a document keeps flipping format | Each scaffold converts `_brand.yml` to its own dialect | Choose one format on purpose; see `vignette("getting-started")` |
| brandkit uses the wrong brand | The cache holds the first `_brand.yml` found when the package loaded | `brand_init("path/to/_brand.yml")` |

## Shiny

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `Navigation containers expect a collection of nav_panel()s` | `brand_page_navbar()` only takes `nav_panel()` / `nav_menu()` items | Put the content inside a `nav_panel()` |
| A gt table stays light in dark mode | gt ignores Bootstrap's CSS variables | Style it from `brand_colors(mode)`; see `vignette("shiny-apps")` |
| A plotly chart doesn't follow the dark-mode toggle in an app | It needs to be told the mode there | `brand_plotly(p, mode = dm$mode())` with `dm <- brand_dark_mode(input)` |
| A leaflet map has a "key required" watermark | CARTO's `Positron` / `DarkMatter` tiles need an API key | Use Esri's grey canvas (a light and a dark version); `create_brand_shiny_map()` ships a helper |
| Map tiles don't change with the mode | Tiles are set when the map renders | Read `dm$mode()` inside `renderLeaflet()` so the map redraws |
| `configure_brand()` fails with "Can't call runApp() from within runApp()" after an interrupted launch | A previous launch left Shiny's running flag set | Install `httpuv`; the configurator clears stuck servers before it starts |

## Documents and PDFs

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| The HTML report's toggle only changes code colours | The theme was written in the flat form | Use `theme: light: [brand, drift.scss]` / `dark: [...]` |
| Plots don't follow the toggle | Figures are static images | `brand_quarto_setup(adaptive = TRUE)`; not available with `embed-resources: true` |
| A plotly chart overflows a slide | It sizes itself to its container | `brand_plotly(p, width = 1000, height = 600)` |
| `quarto render dashboard.qmd` produces files but no running page | The dashboard declares `server: shiny` | `quarto serve dashboard.qmd` |
| A print PDF has a tinted page that clips at the printer's edge | Quarto fills the page with `color.background` | Set `color.background` to white for a print-targeted brand |
| A poster runs onto a second page | Typst doesn't shrink content to fit | Cut content, or use `columns = 4`; a single card taller than a column also overflows |
| The poster's type is the wrong size after changing `papersize:` | The type scale is baked in at scaffold time | Re-run `create_brand_quarto_poster(paper =, columns =)` |
| Generated ornaments or extension values look out of date | They're drawn from the brand at scaffold time | Re-run the `create_brand_quarto_*()` function; changed files are rewritten |

## Fonts

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `**bold**` or `*italic*` renders plain in a PDF | Typst synthesises neither; a family without a 700 or an italic face can't show them | Use a family that ships both. Every pairing the configurator offers does |
| The brand font is missing from a PDF and Typst's default serif appears | Families with an optical-size axis are served as `<Family> <n>pt` (for example `DM Sans 9pt`), which never matches the name you asked for | Pick another family. Check what was downloaded with `quarto typst fonts --font-path <project>/.quarto/typst-font-cache --ignore-system-fonts` |
| Inline code looks too big or too small next to the text | The base font's x-height is far from the code font's | Pick a base font close to IBM Plex Mono's x-height (the offered ones are within 4%, Jost in its pairing about 12% off) |
| Plots (ggplot2, base graphics) don't use the brand font | The fonts aren't registered | Install `sysfonts` and `showtext`; Google fonts need a network connection on first load. `brand_register_fonts()` re-runs registration |
| `library(brandkit)` is slow | Registration downloads Google fonts the first time | `options(brandkit.register_fonts = FALSE)` before loading, then call `brand_register_fonts()` when you want them |
